content: I can’t determine the most likely next items from only the fact that a customer bought item 1873. That requires transaction or co-purchase data for item 1873 and other items.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 1873. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
